tagline: GPS Radar Proximity & Speed Camera Warning System
brief: A modern, reliable automotive safety app for Android, HUD and Wear OS. Warns drivers about speed traps, average speed corridors, and red-light cameras with pinpoint GPS accuracy.

concepts.name: Velocity Iris
concepts.idea: An aerodynamic 3-blade aperture shutter fusing speed turbine dynamics with a precision camera lens pupil.
rationale: Camera & Radar integration: three rotational swept vanes evoke both an optical aperture shutter and a dynamic tachometer turbine.
Uncompromising clarity at 16 px: bold, clean geometry and 12-unit channels ensure zero loss of legibility in status bars and smartwatches.
Automotive presence: Electric Blaze Orange (#FF5E1E) against Carbon Slate delivers instant warning recognition without visual fatigue.

recommendation: Velocity Iris (Concept A) delivers the ideal balance of automotive dynamism, optical precision, and instant recognition across both vehicle HUDs and mobile screens.
